title: Merge Existing Mathematics Textbook SSOT Authority into Governance
purpose: Recognize and register the existing Mono-Process Mathematical Program textbook as the live Mathematics Department SSOT while preserving all current SSOT content unchanged.
principle: Authority is merged into governance; content is preserved.

governance_rules.text: The existing Mono-Process Mathematical Program textbook SHALL be recognized as the live SSOT for the Mathematics Department.
This recognition SHALL NOT replace, rewrite, compress, supersede, or discard existing SSOT content.
The current textbook content SHALL be preserved as inherited live authority.
Future Mathematics Department updates SHALL parse the current textbook SSOT before modifying mathematics-owned artifacts.
New governance metadata MAY be added around the SSOT, but SHALL NOT erase prior mathematical, conceptual, theorem, induction, or governance content.
Executable state remains governed by registries, validators, and audit artifacts; the textbook SSOT governs design intent and update authority.

implementation_steps.action: Register docs/textbook/mono_process_textbook_complete.md as the Mathematics Department live SSOT in authority_manifest.json.
Update departments/mathematics/README.md to state that the textbook is the existing live SSOT.
Create departments/mathematics/AGENTS.md requiring update agents to parse the textbook SSOT before changes.
Add ownership mapping for math registries pointing to the Mathematics Department.
Run the department induction audit again.

DEPT_003.reason: The SSOT exists as the textbook; the gap is governance recognition, not missing content.
